hedgeCoverageRatio.rationale: Metric applies: Final Terms dated 11 Aug 2025 define the Underlying as a crypto-denominated stablecoin yield strategy dynamically allocating to market-neutral opportunities across on-chain markets (spot, lending, arbitrage, derivatives, token rewards); Hyperithm's Compound DAO RFP response independently describes mHYPER as a delta-neutral yield strategy generating returns via funding-rate, RWA, and interest-rate arbitrage across DeFi and centralized venues. No reconciled hedge notional, net delta, long-vs-short inventory, or independent deltaNeutral/overCollateralized boolean is published for mHYPER. Searched and re-opened: Final Terms PDF (no hedge-ratio field); Midas Attestation Engine docs (mHYPER POR feed anchors Hyperithm-disclosed NAV via vLayer/IPFS/Chainlink CRE with LlamaRisk/Canary listed as verifiers — allocation snapshot still 'Planned via 1Token APIs', not a measured hedge ratio); on-chain SaveRegistryWithClaim mhyper-por (attestation hash only; no decodeable coverage ratio); mHYPER/USD oracle (NAV price only); Midas risk-monitoring and strategy-rules pages (platform IM/MM and market-neutrality monitoring policy, no product-level ratio); Fordefi Midas custody case study; midas.app/mhyper and midas.app/transparency (JS/CF-walled, no scrapeable position table); DefiLlama RWA mHYPER notes; Hyperithm Compound post; CoinGecko midas-mhyper. Do not treat market-neutral mandate prose as measured hedgeCoverageRatio=1.

marginBufferPct.rationale: Metric applies: strategy mandate includes derivatives/lending (Final Terms) and risk-monitoring docs describe platform-level Initial/Maintenance Margin (IM/MM) ratio surveillance and leverage limits across Midas products. No mHYPER-specific published excess-margin headroom, maintenance-margin utilization, exchange margin balances, or system overcollateralization (reserves vs token liability) figure usable as marginBufferPct. On-chain mHYPER/USD is a NAV feed (1.11599565 at pin), not excess collateral over liabilities; Final Terms list Custodian/Collateral/Security Agent as n/a for this product. Same search surfaces as hedgeCoverageRatio plus KID_mHYPER.pdf (risk class 7/7; stress scenario total loss) and risk-monitoring page — none disclose a numeric buffer.

lossAbsorptionShare.rationale: Metric applies: synthetic/market-neutral strategies have funding, liquidation, venue, and credit loss paths. Issuer Final Terms set Collateral = n/a and Security Agent = n/a for mHYPER; tokenholders hold a qualified subordinated debt claim with no deposit-protection scheme (KID). No dedicated insurance fund, reserve-fund USD balance, junior first-loss pool size relative to mHYPER supply, or other quantified loss-absorption layer is published for the base mHYPER certificate. Hyperithm's Compound RFP describes a proposed srmHYPER/jrmHYPER senior/junior tranche structure with manager-seeded junior capital — that is a separate proposed tranche product, not a measured absorption share for outstanding mHYPER supply, and is not used here. Searched Final Terms, KID, legal-structure (German Issuer Setup contractual exposure), attestation engine, risk-monitoring, pricing docs, Fordefi case study, Compound RFP, DefiLlama notes — no numeric lossAbsorptionShare surface.
